name: dunter

attributes.attribute: make a racket in old buildings and towers
loud noise warns of death or ill fortune

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Dunter is another name for the powrie. The powrie is a Scottish and British folkloric figure. It is a noisy spirit. It sets up a racket in old buildings and towers. When the noise grows impossibly loud, death or ill fortune is near the hearer. The noise acts as a warning. A person who heard the racket knew that bad luck was coming. This entry directs the reader to the main powrie entry for the full account.
objective: Provide a cross-reference entry that names the dunter as the powrie and defines the powrie.
